Title Update #1 released!
notes.content:
Title update #1 is now available! This content comes as an update, so if you don't have automatic updates turned on, make sure to check for updates before launching the game.

Update notes:
- Fixed several minor bugs regarding some characters and attacks.
- Added a volume option in the Battle screen. Now you are able to control the volume of the soundtrack during battles.
- Added a new area to the game: Seth's Domain!
Seth's Domain is a treacherous region with creatures from ancient times. An old evil god pharaoh has awaken and you must prevent it from fully resurrecting! The new region brings three brand new bosses for you to defeat!

Thank you for all your support towards the game. We look after your feedback and invite you to join our Community forum here on Steam!

notes.title: Title Update #1 Announcement
notes.content:
Battle for Enlor's first title update is on its way with an entire new area and three brand new bosses. Enter Seth's Domain and stop an old evil god from ressurrecting!

All this content will be delivered for free for everyone who owns the game! Along with it there are several fixes for minor bugs, some new features and achievements! The update should be hitting Steam on the next week!

notes.title: Patch released!
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Fixed a bug during "Terr, Scion of Darkness" boss fight where the game would crash.
- The game now supports windowed mode in Windows. Press ALT+ENTER to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode. If any Windows 10 users happen to open the game and only see a black screen, switching modes should fix it.
